summary: TOOL-1 Login with valid and invalid credentials
description:
As a customer, I want to sign in so I can access my account.

* Valid email and password → redirected to the account page, and the user's name shows in the navigation.
* Wrong password → an error message appears and the user stays on the login page.
* Empty fields → each shows a required-field validation message.
* Password field masks the input.

criteria.text: Valid email and password → redirected to the account page, and the user's name shows in the navigation.
Wrong password → an error message appears and the user stays on the login page.
Empty fields → each shows a required-field validation message.

cases.title: Sign in with valid email and password
cases.preconditions: <an existing customer account with a known email and password> exists. Tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter the account's email in the email field.
Enter the account's correct password in the password field.
cases.expected: The user is redirected to the account page, and the user's name is shown in the navigation.

cases.title: Sign in with a valid email but wrong password
cases.preconditions: <an existing customer account with a known email and password> exists. Tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter the account's email in the email field.
Enter a password that is not the account's password in the password field.
cases.expected: An error message appears (exact text not specified in the story) and the user stays on the login page; no redirect to the account page occurs.

cases.title: Submit login form with both fields empty
cases.preconditions: Tester is on the login page and not signed in.
cases.expected: Each field shows a required-field validation message (exact text not specified in the story).

cases.title: Submit login form with only the password filled in
cases.preconditions: <an existing customer account with a known email and password> exists. Tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter the account's password in the password field.
cases.expected: The empty email field shows a required-field validation message (exact text not specified in the story).

cases.title: Submit login form with only the email filled in
cases.preconditions: <an existing customer account with a known email and password> exists. Tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter the account's email in the email field.
cases.expected: The empty password field shows a required-field validation message (exact text not specified in the story).

cases.title: Password field masks typed characters
cases.preconditions: Tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Type <any password value> into the password field.
Observe the characters displayed in the password field.
cases.expected: The typed characters are masked and the password is not displayed in readable form.
